g.desc: USB-UART: CP2102N on 3.3 V, VBUS sensed (R6, R7) and bled (R5)

g.text: Silicon Labs CP2102N Rev. 1.5, Diodes DS37274 (AP7361C), Nexperia PMEG6010CEH, Littelfuse, Wurth, AOS.

g.desc: Silicon Labs CP2102N Rev. 1.5, Diodes DS37274 (AP7361C), Nexperia PMEG6010CEH, Littelfuse, Wurth, AOS.

g.text: Firmware: run the 8 MHz oscillator in low-power mode (HGO = 0): high-gain mode would

g.desc: Firmware: run the 8 MHz oscillator in low-power mode (HGO = 0): high-gain mode would

g.text: overdrive the crystal (AN3208 Eqn. 1), and RF must not be fitted (DS Table 40 note 3).

g.desc: overdrive the crystal (AN3208 Eqn. 1), and RF must not be fitted (DS Table 40 note 3).

g.text: Power: USB-C VBUS through F1 and D1 to the 5 V rail (LDO, RGB LED, 5V pin);

g.desc: Power: USB-C VBUS through F1 and D1 to the 5 V rail (LDO, RGB LED, 5V pin);

g.text: D1 keeps a shield's 5 V off the host. The CP2102N runs from 3.3 V and senses VBUS

g.desc: D1 keeps a shield's 5 V off the host. The CP2102N runs from 3.3 V and senses VBUS

g.text: (R6, R7); R5 bleeds D1's leakage off VBUS, so it connects only with a host present.

g.desc: (R6, R7); R5 bleeds D1's leakage off VBUS, so it connects only with a host present.
